Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Fix accidental extra trailing 1 in row 10 from the transcription.
lines = rows_txt.splitlines(); lines[10] = '1 1 1 1 1 7 1 7 7 7 7 7 1 1 1 1 1 1'; grid = [list(map(int,ln.split())) for ln in lines]
from collections import defaultdict
assert all(len(r)==18 for r in grid)
pts = [(r,c) for r in range(18) for c in range(18) if grid[r][c]==7]
# Four off-axis quadrants around row 9 and col 8
quads = {'NW':[], 'NE':[], 'SW':[], 'SE':[]}
for r,c in pts:
    if r==9 or c==8: continue
    q = ('N' if r<9 else 'S') + ('W' if c<8 else 'E')
    quads[q].append((r,c))
out = [[1]*18 for _ in range(18)]
# translate each quadrant, preserving its pattern and placing its bbox at its matching grid corner
for q,cells in quads.items():
    rmin=min(r for r,c in cells); rmax=max(r for r,c in cells)
    cmin=min(c for r,c in cells); cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
    dr = -rmin if q[0]=='N' else (17-rmax)
    dc = -cmin if q[1]=='W' else (17-cmax)
    for r,c in cells:
        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
        assert out[rr][cc]==1, (q,(rr,cc))
        out[rr][cc]=7
# retain all original 7 on the axes
for r,c in pts:
    if r==9 or c==8: out[r][c]=7
# draw ray from right to left along row 9 through its farthest original 7; from bottom upwards along col 8
for c in range(min(c for r,c in pts if r==9), 18):
    if grid[9][c]==7: out[9][c]=7
    else: out[9][c]=2
for r in range(8,18):
    if grid[r][8]==7: out[r][8]=7
    else: out[r][8]=2
print({q:(len(v), min(r for r,c in v),max(r for r,c in v),min(c for r,c in v),max(c for r,c in v)) for q,v in quads.items()})
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
print('count7',sum(x==7 for row in out for x in row),'count2',sum(x==2 for row in out for x in row))

    rmin=min(r for r,c in cells);rmax=max(r for r,c in cells);cmin=min(c for r,c in cells);cmax=max(c for r,c in cells)
